title: Invasion of the First Order
description: Showing no mercy, soldiers of the First Order invaded the planet Jakku, rounding up innocent villagers as they searched for a missing bit of information. At the same time, Resistance pilot Poe Dameron had been meeting with elderly explorer Lor San Tekká, an Old ally of Leia Organa's. In possession of a clue to the whereabouts of vanished Jedi Luke Skywalker, San Tekka passed this vital information on to Dameron just as the First Order arrived.
section: Star Wars: The Force Awakens #1 of 20
